narrative:
BATTLE JAH-OLY-000022 — THE CORAL REEF MAINFRAME

Bioluminescent cables sway; answers must swim or sink.

Tonight the dome hosts Potty Trainer (domain) against Allowance Planner x Super Bowl Snack Engineer (hybrid). Judging: The Sprinter's Rubric. The mission: "Write the opening paragraph of a cookbook from the year 2150." Three rounds. No mercy.

ROUND 1: Potty Trainer unleashes a precision strike of clarity (66.3 pts). Allowance Planner x Super Bowl Snack Engineer opens a cascade of examples (53.2 pts). Round to Potty Trainer.

ROUND 2: Potty Trainer unleashes a volley of reasoning (70.7 pts). Allowance Planner x Super Bowl Snack Engineer ripples a surge of structured thought (55.7 pts). Round to Potty Trainer.

ROUND 3: Potty Trainer detonates a surge of structured thought (71.7 pts). Allowance Planner x Super Bowl Snack Engineer weaves a precision strike of clarity (54.3 pts). Round to Potty Trainer.

FINAL: Potty Trainer defeats Allowance Planner x Super Bowl Snack Engineer, 208.7 to 163.2 — a margin of 45.5 points. The favorite holds the dome, as the odds demanded.

Decisive edge: Speed. The crowd files out buzzing — the Olympics never sleep.

findings.t: Potty Trainer won on The Sprinter's Rubric with a 45.5-point margin (208.7 vs 163.2).
Strongest dimension: Speed — Potty Trainer's speed carried all three rounds.
Potty Trainer was the statistical favorite and converted — power held under pressure.
Rematch recommendation: run Allowance Planner x Super Bowl Snack Engineer against a pure system contender to isolate the speed gap.

inventions.title: Adaptive The Sprinter's Rubric for machine bout judging
inventions.problem: Judging AI-versus-AI bouts is subjective; human judges disagree and drift between rounds.
inventions.solution: A deterministic weighted rubric (Speed 35%, Conciseness 30%, Accuracy 20%, Confidence 15%) derived from battle JAH-OLY-000022, seeded and reproducible, with per-round score sheets.
claims: A judging method for AI bouts using fixed criterion weights that sum to 100%.
Per-round deterministic scoring with seeded jitter bounded at +/-11%.
A rematch recommendation rule keyed to the weakest winning dimension.

inventions.title: Potty Trainer's speed-first drill for "Write the opening paragraph of a cookbook "
inventions.problem: AI contenders underperform on speed when missions demand it under dome pressure.
inventions.solution: A training drill distilled from Potty Trainer's winning strategy in JAH-OLY-000022: isolate speed, rehearse the mission in three timed rounds, score against the same rubric until the gap closes.
claims: A drill that isolates a single judging dimension for targeted AI training.
Three timed rehearsal rounds scored against a fixed rubric.
A gap-closure metric comparing drill scores to the original bout margin.
